why: Found by I115 while building, before any measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P1 says that without run_routing the driver's run step is I110's two calls, so the protocols before I112 name none of I112's opt-ins (run_routing, disch.section_errors, preflight). It globbed every spec/M[4-6]/lib/i*_run.json except i112_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I115's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i115_run.json, I112's plus three opt-ins) carries I112's opt-ins by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check also skips the protocols of I112 and later keys (an iteration field I112 or above), as I112 amended I111's test_p6. Every earlier protocol is still checked, and the claim is unchanged.
